learningObjective: Trace two logical KV caches through their block tables to scattered physical blocks, and identify why a shared prefix occupies one physical copy with two references.
mediumRationale: A deterministic narrow SVG is the smallest medium that preserves three spatial relationships at once: contiguous logical order, non-contiguous physical placement, and two block-table entries converging on one shared block. Explicit mapping labels keep the lesson readable even when connector paths cross.

mediumComparison.mermaid: Rejected: automatic graph layout can show indirection, but it cannot reliably align both logical sequences and the indexed physical pool or keep repeated mappings stable at phone width.
mediumComparison.svg: Selected: fixed geometry makes logical order, scattered physical indices, free slots, private ownership, and shared reference counts simultaneously inspectable without runtime code.
mediumComparison.semanticHtml: Rejected: a table would provide strong mapping semantics but would make the physical holes and the many-to-one prefix mapping less immediate; the SVG still spells out every mapping and state in text.
mediumComparison.interaction: Rejected: changing block assignments or sequence lengths would add controls and hidden states without improving the single indirection-and-sharing invariant.
mediumComparison.paperReuse: Rejected: the PagedAttention paper contains closely related block-table figures, but its arXiv distribution does not establish a permissive figure-reuse grant. The shipped requests, physical indices, wording, geometry, and styling are independently authored.
mediumComparison.noVisual: Rejected: prose requires the reader to hold logical order, scattered allocation, and aliasing in memory at once. One aligned block-table schematic makes the lookup and shared-prefix invariant directly traceable.

sourceReview.notes: The hardest prose-only mental model is that paging does not reorder a request's tokens. Request A's logical blocks 0, 1, and 2 remain sequential while its block table maps them to scattered physical blocks 7, 1, and 5. Request B can map its matching logical prefix to the same physical blocks 7 and 1, whose reference counts become two, then map its divergent block to a private block. The illustrative indices are synthetic and make no performance claim. A writable partially filled shared block may require copy-on-write; the figure intentionally isolates the stable full-prefix mapping before that mutation.

agentReview.summary: Read the complete article, text-indexed all 214 deck pages, inspected the exact page 113-116 neighborhood, and checked the primary PagedAttention paper plus official vLLM implementation and prefix-caching documentation before selecting an original block-table schematic.

implementation.accessibility: The SVG has a linked title and complete description that states every logical-to-physical mapping, ownership state, and reference count. Mapping text, labels, double-use counts, solid occupied shapes, and dashed free slots make color redundant. The 360-pixel viewBox is designed for 390 CSS-pixel screens with no minimum width; established theme variables preserve dark-mode contrast, and shared print rules force a light high-contrast palette and avoid page breaks inside the figure.
